meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm via GitHub Actions workflow. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 GitHub Actions 自动发布 npm 包
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护 npm 包并想自动化发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate npm package publishing via GitHub Actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an npm package and want to automate releases

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会管理 oh-my-opencode 的完整发布流程：确认版本号、检查代码、触发 GitHub Actions、验证 npm 和 Codex 发布，并在 Discord 发公告。
howto.when: 当你要求发布（如“发布新版本”）并指定版本类型（patch/minor/major）时触发。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本。
say.note: Claude 会确认后执行完整发布流程。

say.text: 发布 minor 版本，跳过 Discord 公告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude manages the full publish workflow for oh-my-opencode: confirms version bump, checks code, triggers GitHub Actions, verifies npm and Codex releases, and posts to Discord.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to publish (e.g., 'publish a new version') and specify a version bump type (patch/minor/major).

say_en.note: Claude will confirm and execute the full workflow.

say_en.text: Publish a minor version, skip Discord announcement.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for bump type but won't skip Discord.
